title: 第二十三章 投名状第二十四章 入局者
content_zh:
灰核城，南区。
晚上十点。
由于袁金刚一伙人状态极度糟糕，是不能在街上拦个出租车回去的，普通人见到的反应是第一时间报警。
更别说阿力舌头都被割了，现在话都讲不出来，只能用分赃的钱，让莫振雄改造一下。
“莫叔，辛苦你了。”
袁金刚坐在副驾驶位置上，由于莫振雄被自己拖下水，是来接自己这帮人的最佳人选。
银灰色涂装的车身切割开雨幕，轮胎碾过的地方溅起污水，红色尾灯在霓虹里拉出一道轨迹。
车辆在往地下街的方向开。
街道墙壁上的荧光涂鸦在雨夜中发出幽绿的光，有的是反抗企业的标语，有的是义体维修店的广告，还有的是街头帮派的图腾，扭曲的线条阴暗天幕的映照下，如同活过来的鬼魅。
“再过两个路口，我就下车。”
王庆是没工夫搞什么团建派对的，他们也赚了一笔大的，想怎么商k褴交都行，明天还要去水星重工打友谊赛。
自己会抽个时间弄个电子文档的功法，让袁金刚他们练。
由于对魔道打击力度可怖。
不能教他们会被判断为魔道的功法，级别不同，一般人修炼百分百遭逮，魔气掩盖不住，只有高手才能完美伪装，避过各种检查站侦测器。
王庆是开创功法的人，早就不拘泥于所谓的正邪，承正之体，纳反之用，进于新境，而成新形。
此时王庆依然在玩着线上赌城。
“买家找到了么？”
王庆向莫振雄问道，根据莫振雄的鉴定，安芷那两件装备卖的钱，可能比今晚的收益都要高。
“一天时间还是太短了，一周内会给你答复。”
莫振雄吞了吞口水，通过后视镜望着后座的王庆，又赶紧收回目光。

大家心中都是明镜。
高校生显然是无法应付今晚这种交易的，王庆是被魔道中人夺舍了。
王庆肯定也知道自己知道。
但莫振雄不是刘子文的小孩儿心性，有些事不上秤只有四两重，一上秤一千斤也打不住。
这层窗户纸很薄，但绝对不能捅破。
“行。”
王庆是不会以兄弟来和手下相称的，不利于大局，发号施令者必须具备权威，使其企划方案有高效执行力。
短暂谈话后氛围有些压抑，尽管王庆只划三百万走，他们几人分的是大头，但袁金刚几人脸上却没有一点高兴。
已知是踏入了没有回头路的深渊。
可怕的沉默后。
袁金刚冷不丁的说了一句。
“庆哥，这票……算是投名状吗？”
袁金刚心中自然也揣测着王庆方才不接电话的用意，眼神冰冷，也是有些发了狠，才问出这句话。
为了攒偷渡的船票，他可以不计一切代价。
莫振雄吓得够呛，在雨天开车稍微颠了一下，赶紧扶正方向盘，让车辆平稳下来。
“投名状？”
王庆熄灭手机屏，饶有兴致，这把线上赌局输了也就输了，并不在乎，“当然算。”
他并没有给出模棱两可的回答，极度明确。
袁金刚愣了会儿，没想到是这么果断的答复，但也只是点了点头，不敢多说。
“我经常刷短视频。现在流行所谓的画饼，但画饼的都是不堪大用的小角色。

我要创建的是秩序，有序的上升通道和考核体系，21层只是方舱一隅，方舱层数有81层，但也只是公示的资料，天地之广阔，假假真真，你不想一窥谜团的答案么？”
至少王庆本人很想知道，到底是什么高端人士，搞出了方舱这么个高端场所，让他都啧啧称奇。
但袁金刚几人却没被激励，愁眉不展，不是所有人都有那么大的野心，只会让人感到可怕。
袁金刚张嘴想说什么。
content_en:
Gray Core City, South District.
10pm.
Because Yuan Jingang and his group were in extremely bad condition, they could not hail a taxi on the street and go back. The reaction of ordinary people was to call the police immediately.
Not to mention that Ali's tongue was cut out and now he can't speak. He can only use the money from the stolen goods to let Mo Zhenxiong reform.
"Uncle Mo, thank you for your hard work."
Yuan Jingang was sitting in the passenger seat. Since Mo Zhenxiong was dragged into the water by him, he was the best person to pick up his group.
The silver-gray painted car body cut through the rain curtain, splashing sewage where the tires ran over, and the red taillights drew a trail in the neon.
The vehicle is heading towards the underground street.
The fluorescent graffiti on the street walls glowed green in the rainy night. Some were slogans against companies, some were advertisements for prosthetic repair shops, and some were totems of street gangs. The twisted lines were like living ghosts against the dark sky.
"After two more intersections, I will get off."
Wang Qing didn't have time to hold any kind of team-building party. They had also made a lot of money, so they could do whatever they wanted and they would go to Mercury Heavy Industries to play a friendly match tomorrow.
I will take some time to prepare an electronic document for the exercises and let Yuan Jingang and the others practice them.
Because of its terrifying strength against the devil.
They cannot be taught techniques that would be judged as demonic. There are different levels. Ordinary people will be caught 100% if they practice. The demonic energy cannot be concealed. Only masters can perfectly disguise themselves and avoid various checkpoint detectors.
Wang Qing is the person who pioneered the practice. He has long been no longer limited to the so-called good and evil.
At this time, Wang Qing was still playing online casino.
"Has the buyer been found?"
Wang Qing asked Mo Zhenxiong. According to Mo Zhenxiong's appraisal, the price of An Zhi's two pieces of equipment might be higher than tonight's profit.
"One day is still too short. I will give you a reply within a week."
Mo Zhenxiong swallowed, looked at Wang Qing in the back seat through the rearview mirror, and quickly looked away.
Everyone has a clear mind.
College students obviously cannot cope with this kind of transaction tonight. Wang Qing was taken away by someone from the devil's way.
Wang Qing must also know that he knows.
But Mo Zhenxiong is not like Liu Ziwen's kid. Some things only weigh four taels if they are not weighed on the scale, and they cannot be stopped if they are weighed a thousand kilograms.
This layer of window paper is very thin, but it must not be punctured.
"Okay."
Wang Qing will not treat his subordinates as brothers, which is not conducive to the overall situation. Those who give orders must have authority so that their plans can be executed efficiently.
After a short conversation, the atmosphere became a bit depressing. Although Wang Qing only allocated 3 million, and they shared the bulk, there was no joy on the faces of Yuan Jingang and others.
It is known that we have entered an abyss from which there is no turning back.
After a terrible silence.
Yuan Jingang said abruptly.
"Brother Qing, is this vote... considered a vote for a certificate?"
Yuan Jinjiang naturally speculated on Wang Qing's intention for not answering the phone just now. His eyes were cold and he was a little fierce before he asked this question.
In order to save the ferry ticket for smuggling, he would do whatever it takes.
Mo Zhenxiong was so frightened that he bumped slightly while driving on a rainy day. He quickly straightened the steering wheel to stabilize the vehicle.
"A certificate of nomination?"
Wang Qing turned off the screen of his mobile phone and was very interested. If he loses this online gambling game, he loses it. He doesn't care, "Of course it counts."
He didn't give an ambiguous answer, he was extremely clear.
Yuan Jingang was stunned for a while, not expecting such a decisive reply, but he just nodded and did not dare to say more.
"I often watch short videos. Nowadays, the so-called painting pie is popular, but the people painting pie are small characters who cannot be used in a big way.
What I want to create is order, an orderly ascending passage and assessment system. The 21st floor is just a corner of the cabin. There are 81 cabins, but it is only public information. The world is vast, false and true. Don’t you want to get a glimpse of the answer to the mystery? "
At least Wang Qing himselfHe really wanted to know who the high-end people were who created such a high-end place like Fangcang, which made him marvel.
But Yuan Jingang and the others were not motivated, and looked gloomy. Not everyone had such great ambitions, which would only make people feel terrible.
Yuan Jingang opened his mouth to say something.
